verdict.rationale: Remote-access tools could reasonably show active connections on the host and let the user disconnect or revoke devices, so this axis applies to TeamViewer. However, nothing in the evidence documents a host-side view of who is connected right now, or a way to end a session or revoke a device from the host. Related items such as the concurrent-connection definition, admin-managed devices and audit logs are adjacent features and do not demonstrate this capability.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
